fato_historico: 1702: English colonists under the command of James Moore besiege Spanish St. Augustine during Queen Anne's War.

It is a good time to evaluate your foundations and ensure your daily routine serves your highest good. Focus on steady progress and gentle structural improvements.
frase_do_dia: Steady steps lead to the most beautiful and lasting landscapes of the soul.
